caption: Novartis AG v. Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC
citation_line: Novartis AG v. Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC, No. 2:25-cv-00849, ECF No. 111 (D.N.J. Aug. 4, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied without prejudice discovery into why Novartis filed a trade-dress and trademark action over generic ENTRESTO tablets. Subjective filing motives were not relevant to laches on the record presented, and a possible future Lanham Act fee claim did not justify the request.
qualification_rationale: Focused guidance on the boundary between merits discovery and litigation-motive discovery in pharmaceutical trademark litigation.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Non-dispositive dispute over the permissible scope of trademark discovery.
